profile_registry: 共享/运营/SOP/生图风格档案.json

tasks.purpose: 作为公众号封面，用一个清晰主体表现 AI 加速资料流动、人的判断仍处于工作中心。

final_stage.content_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: WeChat technology essay cover. Create a mature editorial visual about AI reorganizing work rather than replacing an entire job. Show one human researcher at a desk in three-quarter view. One hand sorts a small set of printed research papers and evidence cards; the other hand deliberately guides a luminous stream of document fragments, task nodes, and connecting lines into a new arrangement. The human is visibly attentive and in control, expressing judgment rather than passivity. Use a refined mixed-media editorial illustration with tactile paper-collage textures, subtle dimensional lighting, and a restrained ivory, charcoal, coral, and cobalt palette. Keep one strong central focal point and generous clean margins. The visual should feel like a sophisticated technology magazine cover, not a cartoon or corporate advertisement.
output_constraints: Very wide landscape composition suitable for a 2.35:1 WeChat cover crop
Keep the human, hands, papers, and main light flow inside the central 60% safe area so both wide and square crops remain meaningful
No title, captions, labels, UI copy, or other legible text
Readable as a small mobile thumbnail without relying on tiny details
avoid: Robots firing workers, layoffs scenes, sad office workers, replacement metaphors, giant brains, humanoid AI faces, or threatening machinery
Doodle style, childish line art, meme aesthetics, generic stock-photo polish, or decorative clutter
Patreon, Google, Gemini, Image2, or any third-party logos and trademarks
Logos, trademarks, watermarks, extra text, garbled text, fake interfaces, charts, or unverified claims
